contrastRemediationContract.consumer: Claude H9 contrast cleanup in app/styles.css
contrastRemediationContract.rule: Use this as an app-owned remediation checklist; Codex supplies tokens and warnings but does not edit app CSS.

steps.label: Wire --accent-text on accent action surfaces
steps.warning: dark white on accent action contrast 2.01 is below 4.5
appOwnedEvidence: Dark-theme accent buttons and action surfaces use --accent-text rather than literal #fff.
npm run audit:contrast no longer reports dark white on accent action.
mustNot: Do not keep literal #fff text on the light green dark-theme accent.
Do not solve this by lowering the 4.5 contrast floor.

steps.label: Move tiny hint-on-pill text to a stronger foreground
steps.warning: light hint on pill contrast 4.28 is below 4.5
appOwnedEvidence: Small text on pill fills uses a darker foreground such as --muted or --ink, or the app token pair is adjusted.
npm run audit:contrast no longer reports light hint on pill.
mustNot: Do not leave sub-AA small hint text on pill surfaces.
Do not make pills visually louder just to avoid changing the foreground.

steps.label: Move tiny hint-on-track text to a stronger foreground
steps.warning: light hint on track contrast 3.97 is below 4.5
appOwnedEvidence: Small text on track badges uses a darker foreground such as --muted or --ink, or the app token pair is adjusted.
npm run audit:contrast no longer reports light hint on track.
mustNot: Do not keep low-contrast helper text on track badges.
Do not hide the text to avoid the contrast decision.

steps.label: Raise muted-on-track contrast above the edge
steps.warning: light muted on track contrast 4.48 is below 4.5
appOwnedEvidence: Muted text on track surfaces either crosses AA or uses --ink where the text is small.
npm run audit:contrast no longer reports light muted on track.
mustNot: Do not accept an edge-case 4.48 pair as passing for normal text.
Do not rely on font weight or size changes without verifying the actual text use.

steps.label: Avoid accent-as-small-text on track fills
steps.warning: light accent on track contrast 4.34 is below 4.5
appOwnedEvidence: Accent text on track fills is replaced with a passing text token or the pair is adjusted.
npm run audit:contrast no longer reports light accent on track.
mustNot: Do not use color alone to carry action or status meaning.
Do not make track surfaces darker without checking every other track text pair.

sharedEvidenceRequired: Run npm run audit:contrast after the app CSS change.
Keep icon-only labels and focus-visible coverage green while changing the color pairs.
Leave the design-token source as data unless app/design explicitly chooses a new token source.

skinReadiness.appOwnedNext: Wear this substrate in app/app.js and app/styles.css, then judge the running app visually and accessibly; this generated contract is not visual sign-off.
